notes.title: Illwinter's Floorplan Generator 1.46
notes.content:
This update modernizes IFG and makes sure it runs nicely on new computers. Mac users now requires an ARM Mac (M1+) in order to run the latest version of the program. Old Mac users can still use the old version by selecting the legacy beta branch in steam. There are also a few new features and bug fixes, including a new setting to start with all icon categories folded.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Will no longer crash if loading a mod with a corrupted PNG terrain texture
[*] Can now choose between horizontal and vertical hex grids
[*] New option to start with all icon categories folded
[*] Improved text alpha filtering
[*] Increased max nbr of icons 20000 -> 40000
[*] Windows got updated SDL libs to better support modern versions of Windows
[*] Mac version is now built for modern ARM Macs (M1+)
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Will no longer crash if loading a mod with a corrupted PNG terrain texture

tags.feature: [*] Can now choose between horizontal and vertical hex grids
[*] New option to start with all icon categories folded

notes.title: Illwinter's Floorplan Generator 1.34
notes.content:
This update aims to make life easier when using workshop mods. The previous scale used for an icon will be remembered between different sessions of using Illwinter's Floorplan Generator. Also the number of icons loaded will be shown when starting up the editor, making it more clear how long time it will take to load and how many icons you have installed.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Remember old icon scale
[*] New start option: --noremeberscale
[*] Faster PNG image loading
[*] Print number of icons/terrains loaded while waiting
[*] Finer scaling for icons at very small scales (2 - 10%)
[/list]

- Finer scaling for icons at very small scales (2 - 10%)

notes.title: Illwinter's Floorplan Generator 1.33
notes.content:
This update makes it much easier to use modded terrains in random dungeons. The modded terrains will now stay the same even if the mods or the program is updated. There is also a new feature to put icons with a bit a random scaling applied, useful when creating lots of trees and bushes. The undo functionality has also been improved and will now work more reliably.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Random dungeons can now load/save modded terrains properly
[*] Can now undo removal/creation of extra dungeon levels
[*] Can now undo crop to selection rectangle
[*] Can now undo resize dungeon
[*] Option (alt-z) to randomly scale each icon
[*] Randomly rotate icons key changed to alt-x
[*] Improved performance for loading PNG icons
[*] Windows version can now find Gimp 3 beta versions as well
[/list]

[*] Icon support for random dungeons
[*] Random classic Black & White dungeon

[*] Foundry VTT dynamic lightning support
[*] Fix for bad icons when pressing alt+d and alt+t on black & white backgrounds
[*] shift+h for vertical mirroring of icon
[*] Use alt to grab keys in random dungeons (was ctrl)
[*] Mirror room in Random Dungeon Scheme Editor changed to ctrl-m
[*] shift+f to fill walls only in selected area
[*] ctrl-a to select all

[*] Fixed display bug after shrinking a higher level map
[*] Fixed graphics bug on left edge of higher level maps
[*] Configurable dead end removal for random dungeons
[*] A few new icons

Users of Roll20 can now get walls to interact with the lightning automatically (file menu / quick export settings). In this update are also the performance improvements from the previous 1.20 version that was reverted due to a crash bug.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Elevation differences will change texture brightness
[*] New mud, grass, cliff and moss terrains
[*] New water terrains
[*] Water terrains now have their own category
[*] New icons: Logs, Arrow Slits
[*] New giant mushroom icons
[*] Loading of edges didn't always work properly when using mods
[*] Top left square could be drawn when it should not be, fixed
[*] Fix for crash when loading large dungeons
[*] Roll20 dynamic lightning support
[/list]

notes.title: Illwinter's Floorplan Generator 1.0 released
notes.content:
Almost one year after IFG's early access started the floorplan generator is now at version 1.0 and is being released for real. Notable new features are elevation levels for floors, automatic conversion of colored dungeons to black and white style, diagonal edge walls and new icons and terrains.

There are many changes for icons in version 1.0 compared to the early access version and old save files might load with incorrect or misplaced icons. A little tweaking of the icons can be required for some old maps to look ok again.


[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Can adjust elevation levels for floors in dungeon

[*] Copy & paste for terrain

[*] Subfolders for Black & White icons
[*] Can change between windows drives in file selector
[*] File selector for save floorplan
[*] Remember last directory for export PNG
[*] Fix for starting external programs in windows
[*] Increased maximum number of terrains 100 -> 200
[*] New command line option: --export
[*] Terrain __l = only no shadow
[*] Terrain __c = draw below other things
[*] Brighter tool highlight
[*] Renaming and reorganization of many icons
[/list]
